prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for most kinds of change, as few categories have at least two tests that agree after noise correction.
Home new_flow changes showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Choose_path copy, home wait_info, and sign_in hint changes have produced winning tests, though outcomes vary by specific test.
Predictions in early rounds were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected results.
Predictions in Round 3 were too low, underestimating winning changes such as sign-in hints and path selection copy.
Tests with no clear effect must be treated as having no effect, even when noise-corrected estimates lean positive.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Path Choice Redesign: Redesign the onboarding welcome story into a continuous story scroll layout leading directly into companion path selection. (why: The choose_path step takes a median of 8s but mean of 514s; presenting a cohesive story scroll flow improves context before choosing a path.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Companion Path Preview Screen: Insert a new companion preview screen before path selection showcasing differences between instant adoption and custom generation. (why: Adoption step drops to 69.5%, suggesting users need clearer expectations of what each path provides before selecting.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Sign In Before Adoption Certificate Reorder: Move sign-in step to immediately follow photo upload/pet choice before generating the adoption certificate. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after re-authenticating; securing accounts right after pet creation ensures persistence.)
3: [finish, redesign] Desktop Spotlight Home Intro Redesign: Redesign the home_intro completion view into a spotlight layout that focuses attention on your newly spawned desktop companion. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% with mean time 5815s; 3 support tickets noted pet visibility issues on desktop.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Recovery Hint: Add a prominent persistence hint on the sign-in screen informing users how logging in safeguards pet data across installs. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again; sign_in hints have proven to be winning tests in prior rounds.)
5: [home, wait_info] Generation Progress Time Estimate: Display explicit progress counters and time estimates while waiting for pet companion generation on the home waiting screen. (why: Home waiting median time is 201s (mean 2336s); previous lessons show wait_info changes effectively keep users engaged.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Choose Path Reassurance Copy: Update the body text on choose_path screen to clarify that additional pets and custom options can be unlocked anytime later. (why: Path selection copy adjustments are backed by previous winning tests, reducing initial choice friction (83.5% conversion).)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Notification Prompt: Enable optional desktop notifications on the waiting screen to alert users when generation completes. (why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s; background notification prevents users from missing when their pet lands on the desktop.)
8: [adoption, layout] Card Layout Adoption Certificate: Switch adoption_certificate screen layout to card layout to clearly structure companion details and final confirmation action. (why: Adoption step conversion is 69.5% with median 89s; card layout organizes key pet details into a digestible view.)
9: [finish, new_screen] Companion Mastery Intro Screen: Add a new screen at the end of onboarding highlighting primary interaction shortcuts like right-clicking and hiding your pet. (why: Support mailbox received 3 inquiries on how to control/hide/talk to pets, and finish step drops to 64.8% completion.)
